description: Stores: prepare (unsigned) the fee for moving your store up a tier, paid in ZENI into the reward pool (approve the exact amount, then RewardPool.fund). Only when your sales have earned the tier. After it is mined call store_upgrade_confirm with the transaction hash.

wallet.description: Your own 0x wallet address. Nothing is sent from it; it is used to read your balance and allowance and to simulate.

name: prepare_store_upgrade
